Shows a portion of Salinas Bay and associated coast between Morro Hermoso and Arroyo Hondo.

Shows a portion of Salinas Bay and associated coast between Morro Hermoso and Arroyo Hondo. Depths shown by soundings. Prime meridian: Tenerife. Watermark: IV. Pen-and-ink and watercolor. Mounted on cloth backing. Annotated in brown ink in lower right corner: Concuerta. con su oris[?] Pedro Rivelles. Maggs number annotated in pencil in lower right margin: 159. LC Luso-Hispanic World, 287 Available also through the Library of Congress Web site as a raster image. Vault
